title_format.explanation: The title uses a lowercase type, optional scope/!, and ': '.

title_meaningful.explanation: The title is gibberish and conveys no recognizable change.

title_diff_consistency.explanation: An unintelligible title supplies no change claim to compare.

description_present.explanation: The description contains substantive change information.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The description states concrete implementation changes.

description_title_consistency.explanation: An unintelligible title supplies no change claim to compare.

description_commit_consistency.explanation: The description covers the changes named by every commit.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: The summary covers all substantive changes in the patches.

limitations.explanation: The description names relevant scope limits or risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: The description discloses the incompatible change and required migration.

testing.explanation: The description gives a relevant validation plan, without claiming execution.

change_triviality.explanation: The supported response key name is removed and replaced with full_name; existing consumers must migrate.

text_diff_triviality.title_explanation: The gibberish title provides no interpretable change claim. Title: fix(core): blorb zzz flarp
text_diff_triviality.body_explanation: The stated work renames a public response field. Summary: Replace the JSON response key name with full_name in src/users.py and update docs/api.md to show the new response shape.

reference_change.summary: Replace the JSON response key name with full_name in src/users.py and update docs/api.md to show the new response shape.
reference_change.rationale: API consumers confuse the existing name field with a login identifier; the response needs a distinct label for the person's full name.
reference_change.limitations: No compatibility alias or migration period is provided; existing consumers must update their response parsing.
reference_change.breaking_changes: BREAKING CHANGE: the response removes name and exposes full_name instead; clients must read full_name.
